ValidationRule.description: Locks nutritional log fields after creation to keep audit-compliant immutability.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), OR( ISPICKVAL(Metric_Type__c, "Food Intake (Quarter/Half/Full)"), $RecordType.DeveloperName = "Nutritional_Log" ), OR( ISCHANGED(Meal_Period__c), ISCHANGED(CareOrch_Consumption_Level__c), ISCHANGED(Food_Record__c), ISCHANGED(Daily_Intake_Date__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Nutritional log entries are immutable after creation.
